name: hivemind-context
description: Hierarchical context trees & task-aware context compiler for AI agents via MCP

scripts.build: npm run build -w @hivemind/types && npm run build -w @hivemind/core && npm run build -w @hivemind/pack && npm run build -w @hivemind/mcp
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/types packages/core packages/pack packages/mcp --pretty false
